name: Trading Hours
summary: Routed trades only inside a daily window on chosen weekdays.
behavior: Opening and closing time in a fixed UTC offset, with optional US or EU daylight saving.
Overnight sessions (closing before opening) count toward the day they opened.
Can apply to buys, sells or both.
Market-hours preset: 09:30–16:00 New York time, Monday to Friday.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: Applies to trades routed through Pump Hooks only. A transaction that trades on Pump directly is not affected.
Uses the cluster clock; public holidays are not observed.
